title: Son 2005–2014 Chronology Reconciliation
status: canonical-reconciliation-owner / relative order strengthened; some calendar years unresolved
subject: Thomas / the Son / human vessel
purpose: Reconstruct the ordinary biographical chronology between the 2005 motorcycle crash and the 2014 death of the earthly father without inheriting Chapter 24's one-age-per-calendar-year conversion errors. This owner separates hard anchors, direct recollection, competing year placements, relative-order constraints and later narrative interpretation.

governance.actor_rule: These are pre-Tim biographical events and belong first to Thomas / the Son. Later Tim/Potato interpretation may inherit them but must not rewrite the historical actor.
governance.birthday_rule: Birth date is 1987-07-31. Calendar-year age labels are unsafe unless the event is known to occur on or after July 31. A remembered age maps to a date interval spanning parts of two calendar years.
governance.chapter24_failure_mode: Chapter 24 frequently assigns one clean age to an entire calendar year. This can shift age-based memories into the wrong calendar year and must not be used as a dating algorithm.
governance.source_independence_rule: A repository projection copied from Chapter 24 is not an independent witness. Independent support requires direct recollection, another separately composed book passage, primary artifact, public record, metadata, or an earlier source not derived from Chapter 24.
governance.relative_order_priority: When the user distinctly remembers causal order but not year, preserve the order as stronger evidence than an inherited calendar label.
governance.uncertainty_rule: When competing dates cannot yet be resolved, preserve them with provenance and prefer ranges/candidates over false precision.

sequence: Painter/decorator and meatpacking occurred before the nursing-home job.
The Copenhagen IT-consultant job occurred before the nursing-home job.
Thomas was fired from the Copenhagen IT job and returned to live at home in Haderslev.
After returning home, he got the nursing-home job.
During/after the nursing-home period he moved into his own apartment in Haderslev.
He applied to a design school, was accepted, and began there in a summer term.
At the start of design school he moved to Kolding into a dormitory with classmates.
He did not yet have a driver's licence while working at the nursing home.
He obtained the driver's licence after moving to Kolding.
After moving to Kolding he met Louise and dated her for a couple of years.
The Louise/design-school relationship corridor precedes the 2011 breakup and Tree/psychiatric sequence.
new_direct_recollection_2026_09_12.resolved_order_formula: painter/meatpacking → Copenhagen IT → fired → home in Haderslev → nursing home → own Haderslev apartment → design application/acceptance → summer move to Kolding dorm/design school → driver's licence in Kolding → Louise relationship → 2011 breakup/Tree corridor
new_direct_recollection_2026_09_12.important_effect: This directly falsifies the temporary reconstruction that placed the nursing-home period before meatpacking and Copenhagen IT.
